title: Rests and time signatures
goal: Count silent beats and feel the difference between 4/4 and 3/4.

steps.title: What is a rest?
steps.text: A rest is a pause in the music. You do not play, but you still count it, in your head, so you come back in on time.

steps.title: Four beats in a bar
steps.text: Music is cut into bars. 4/4 means four beats in each bar: count 1 2 3 4. Beat 1 gets a higher click so you know where the bar starts.

steps.title: A rest on beat 3
steps.text: Play on 1, 2 and 4. On 3 stay silent and keep counting.

steps.title: Three beats in a bar
steps.text: 3/4 means three beats in each bar: count 1 2 3. Waltzes are in 3/4. Feel the strong beat 1, then two light ones.

steps.title: A waltz with a rest
steps.text: Play on 1 and 3. Stay silent on 2.

steps.title: Three notes, one rest
steps.text: Play C on 1, E on 2, G on 4. Rest on 3.

steps.title: Check: rests in time
steps.text: Count out loud and keep the rests silent.
